task: On Apple's website, how many different types of keyboards are available when customizing your 14-inch MacBook Pro?
answer: 20 different types of keyboards are available when customizing your 14-inch MacBook Pro. On apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-pro, after selecting the 14-inch MacBook Pro and advancing through the configuration steps, the Keyboard customization card's language selector lists exactly 20 options: U.S. English, Arabic, British English, Chinese (Pinyin), Chinese (Zhuyin), Danish, Dutch, French Canadian, French, German, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Latin America), Spanish, Swiss, and Ukrainian.
